name: PHP Web (FrankenPHP)
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
PHP website or Laravel app served by FrankenPHP, a single static binary with PHP and the Caddy web
server built in. Only the configured document root (public/ by default) is served. Composer, Laravel
migrations, the scheduler and a queue worker can run on start.
startup: if [ ! -f start.sh ]; then echo "start.sh is missing: the installation did not finish. Reinstall the server and check the install output for the line starting with Install failed."; exit 1; fi; bash ./start.sh

#!/bin/bash # PHP Web (FrankenPHP) install script # # Server Files: /mnt/server set -e trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR apt-get update apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates git jq unzip case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) ARCH=x86_64 ;; aarch64) ARCH=aarch64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;; esac mkdir -p /mnt/server/www cd /mnt/server # FrankenPHP: the plain linux build is fully static (musl) and runs on any yolk if [ -z "${FRANKENPHP_VERSION}" ] || [ "${FRANKENPHP_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then RELEASE_URL=https://api.github.com/repos/php/frankenphp/releases/latest else RELEASE_URL=https://api.github.com/repos/php/frankenphp/releases/tags/v${FRANKENPHP_VERSION#v} fi DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_URL}" | jq -r --arg name "frankenphp-linux-${ARCH}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url') if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then DOWNLOAD_URL=https://github.com/php/frankenphp/releases/latest/download/frankenphp-linux-${ARCH} fi echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}" curl -fsSL -o frankenphp "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" chmod 755 frankenphp ./frankenphp version curl -fsSL -o composer.phar https://getcomposer.org/download/latest-stable/composer.phar # a regular "php" command for composer scripts, artisan and the console; # frankenphp php-cli does not understand -d, so leading ini overrides are dropped mkdir -p bin cat > bin/php <<'EOF' #!/bin/bash while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in -d) shift 2 ;; -d*) shift ;; *) break ;; esac done exec "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/../frankenphp" php-cli "$@" EOF chmod 755 bin/php export PATH=/mnt/server/bin:${PATH} PHP_BINARY=/mnt/server/bin/php # deploy from git when a repository is configured and www/ is still empty if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ] && [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" != "1" ]; then GIT_ARGS=() if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then GIT_ARGS=(-c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "${USERNAME}" "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" | base64 -w0)") fi if [ -z "$(ls -A www)" ]; then echo "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS}" git "${GIT_ARGS[@]}" clone ${BRANCH:+--branch "${BRANCH}"} --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" www elif [ -d www/.git ]; then echo "www/ already contains a repository, pulling" git "${GIT_ARGS[@]}" -C www pull --ff-only else echo "www/ is not empty and not a git repository, leaving it alone" fi fi if [ -z "$(ls -A www)" ]; then mkdir -p "www/${DOCUMENT_ROOT}" cat > "www/${DOCUMENT_ROOT}/index.php" <<'EOF' It works

It works

Upload your site into www/.

EOF fi if [ -f www/composer.json ]; then echo "Running composer install" (cd www && php ../composer.phar install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction --no-progress) \ || echo "composer install failed, it runs again on the next start" fi if [ ! -f Caddyfile ]; then cat > Caddyfile <<'EOF' { admin off auto_https off persist_config off skip_install_trust servers { trusted_proxies static private_ranges client_ip_headers X-Forwarded-For X-Real-IP } frankenphp { php_ini memory_limit {$PHP_MEMORY_LIMIT:256M} php_ini upload_max_filesize {$PHP_UPLOAD_LIMIT:64M} php_ini post_max_size {$PHP_UPLOAD_LIMIT:64M} php_ini max_execution_time 60 php_ini expose_php Off php_ini display_errors Off php_ini log_errors On php_ini allow_url_include Off php_ini session.cookie_httponly 1 php_ini session.cookie_samesite Lax php_ini session.use_strict_mode 1 php_ini session.cookie_secure {$SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE:1} php_ini date.timezone {$TZ:UTC} } } :{$SERVER_PORT} { root * /home/container/www/{$DOCUMENT_ROOT} encode zstd gzip header { X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" -Server -X-Powered-By } @hidden { path */.* not path /.well-known/* } @sensitive path *.env *.ini *.log *.sql *.sqlite *.bak *.old *.orig *.swp *.dist *.lock *.yml *.yaml *.sh *.md composer.json package.json respond @hidden 404 respond @sensitive 404 php_server } EOF ./frankenphp fmt --overwrite Caddyfile fi # rewritten on every reinstall so fixes reach existing servers; put custom steps in www/ instead cat > start.sh <<'EOF' #!/bin/bash cd /home/container export PATH=/home/container/bin:${PATH} PHP_BINARY=/home/container/bin/php git_auth() { if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then git -c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "${USERNAME}" "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" | base64 -w0)" "$@" else git "$@" fi } if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ] && [ -d www/.git ]; then echo "Pulling latest changes" git_auth -C www pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed, starting with the current files" fi cd www if [ "${COMPOSER_INSTALL}" == "1" ] && [ -f composer.json ]; then php ../composer.phar install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction --no-progress fi if [ "${LARAVEL}" == "1" ] && [ -f artisan ]; then if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo "www/.env is missing. Create it from .env.example before enabling Laravel mode." exit 1 fi if grep -qE '^APP_KEY=\s*$' .env; then php artisan key:generate --force fi php artisan migrate --force php artisan optimize if [ "${LARAVEL_SCHEDULER}" == "1" ]; then php artisan schedule:work & fi if [ "${LARAVEL_QUEUE}" == "1" ]; then php artisan queue:work --sleep=3 --tries=3 --max-time=3600 & fi fi cd /home/container exec ./frankenphp run --config Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile EOF chmod 755 start.sh echo "-----------------------------------------" echo "Installation completed" echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Document Root
variables.description: Folder inside www/ that is served to visitors. public for Laravel and most frameworks, . to serve www/ itself (WordPress).

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a repository cloned into www/ on install.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Empty uses the default branch.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token with read access. It is sent as a header and never written into .git/config.

variables.name: Pull On Start
variables.description: git pull --ff-only before every start when www/ is a repository.

variables.name: Manual Upload
variables.description: Ignore the repository settings and manage www/ yourself over SFTP.

variables.name: Composer Install On Start
variables.description: Run composer install --no-dev on every start when www/composer.json exists.

variables.name: Laravel
variables.description: Run artisan migrate --force and artisan optimize on start.

variables.name: Laravel Scheduler
variables.description: Run artisan schedule:work in the background (needs Laravel enabled).

variables.name: Laravel Queue Worker
variables.description: Run artisan queue:work in the background (needs Laravel enabled).

variables.name: Secure Session Cookie
variables.description: Mark the PHP session cookie Secure. Keep 1 behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, set 0 only for testing over plain HTTP.

variables.name: FrankenPHP Version
variables.description: latest or a release such as 1.13.4. Reinstall to change.
